name: dsm-booking-system
description: Digital Services Master — multi-industry booking pages and website scheduler, built for Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/seed-demo.mjs > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute dsm-booking --local --file=.wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: node scripts/seed-demo.mjs > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute dsm-booking --remote --file=.wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev
